SELECT b.projectId AS projectId, b.name AS name, b.clientName AS clientName, b.status AS status, b.startedOn AS startedOn, b.endedOn AS endedOn, b.contractAmount AS contractAmount, b.totalStepCount AS totalStepCount, b.doneStepCount AS doneStepCount, b.myIssueInProgressCount AS myIssueInProgressCount, b.myApprovalInProgressCount AS myApprovalInProgressCount, bc.business_category_id AS categoryId, bc.name AS categoryName, bc.code AS categoryCode, (bc.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS categoryDeleted, pm.user_id AS memberUserId, e.name AS memberName, (e.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS memberDeleted FROM ( SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS name, p.client_name AS clientName, p.status AS status, p.started_on AS startedOn, p.ended_on AS endedOn, p.contract_amount AS contractAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM step s WHERE s.project_id = p.project_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL) AS totalStepCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM step s WHERE s.project_id = p.project_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status = 'DONE') AS doneStepCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issue i JOIN issue_assign ia ON ia.issue_id = i.issue_id AND ia.user_id = #{requesterUserId} JOIN step si ON si.step_id = i.step_id AND si.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE si.project_id = p.project_id AND i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND i.deleted_at IS NULL) AS myIssueInProgressCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval a JOIN block bl ON bl.block_id = a.block_id AND bl.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN step sa ON sa.step_id = bl.step_id AND sa.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sa.project_id = p.project_id AND a.user_id = #{requesterUserId} AND a.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) AS myApprovalInProgressCount, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM project p
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.project_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) b LEFT JOIN project_business_category pbc ON pbc.project_id = b.projectId
LEFT JOIN business_category bc ON bc.business_category_id = pbc.business_category_id AND bc.company_id = #{companyId} LEFT JOIN project_member pm ON pm.project_id = b.projectId AND pm.permission <> 'NONE' LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = pm.user_id ORDER BY b.createdAt DESC, b.projectId DESC, bc.business_category_id ASC, e.name ASC, pm.user_id ASC
